name: Al Muqaddim
description: Allah brings forward whom and what He wills in accordance with His wisdom.
summary: Al Muqaddim expresses Allah's bringing forward according to His wisdom, including advancement in rank. It is paired with Al Mu'akhkhir in the Arabic supplication in Muslim 771a. Quran 16:61 is a related passage about appointed terms, not a literal occurrence of the name.
